About three quarters of sales are in stores; no pixel sees them. Judged on online alone, video looks like it loses money.

gaps.between: Test window and the long run
gaps.why: Awareness built in the launch keeps selling after the flight. A six-week read sees only the start of it; the cooldown read sees a little more.

vendor_brief: Ask aided awareness with the same brand list and wording as the platform's in-feed poll. The vendor's longer list reads lower, so today the two cannot be set side by side without a bridge.
Add a boost sample of heavy platform users, or weight by time spent on the platform. The panel under-recruits them: by week 103 the panel frame reads 16.7% where the whole population is at 17.6%.
Time the waves to the plan's read dates (launch, end of brand lift, end of the geo test) and double the sample in launch months: 2,000 a wave detects a 4.1pp change between waves, 1,000 needs 5.7pp.
